dedupe_keys.name: floridyn jl a dynamic wind farm simulation software

description: Uwe Fechner and Marcus Becker at Delft University of Technology publish a Julia implementation of FLORIDyn for dynamic wind-farm simulation. The model uses Gaussian wakes to estimate generated power, added turbulence and wake-induced losses under heterogeneous, time-varying wind speeds and directions. Zenodo archives version 0.5.6 from October 2025, free under BSD 3-Clause; the repository states a separate CC BY 4.0 licence for documentation. Coverage depends on user-specified farm layouts and conditions. The current README supports Julia 1.10 and 1.11 and supplies runnable examples, but reports only the IterateOPs_basic implementation. This version can support dynamic wake-control and farm-operation studies. It is translated from the MATLAB FLORIDyn model, whose describing paper is cited; the Python OFF implementation is another related project. No existing catalogue parent explicitly covers this Julia release. Claimed speed gains and example execution were not checked.
